name: anki-workflows
description: Add, review, standardize, and migrate non-duplicate Anki cards directly or from Todoist and macOS Reminders.

interface.shortDescription: Add, migrate, or update reviewed Anki cards from prompts, Todoist, or Reminders.
interface.longDescription: Inspect a local Anki collection, use a standard English note type and card-length rules, add, migrate, or update non-duplicate cards through AnkiConnect, sync them, and optionally process learning tasks from Todoist or macOS Reminders.
defaultPrompt: Add or update these cards in my existing Anki setup without duplicates, then sync.
Review my English-learning cards for consistent prompts, punctuation, examples, and vocabulary supplements.
Review pending language-learning tasks from Todoist or Reminders, add the useful cards to Anki, and sync.
